Maya: Quick heads-up — two pilot accounts (Arcadia Health + Brightlane) surfaced overlapping asks during onboarding.
Maya: Can we capture these into a single priority lane so Product can triage tomorrow? TL;DR: onboarding docs gaps, per-route billing clarity, and token-cost spikes on long prompts.
Tom: +1. Arcadia reported that the sample prompts in quickstart return inconsistent summaries depending on model version.
Tom: log excerpt from Arcadia:
```
request_id: 9f4a2b
model: rwd-xl-v1
prompt: patient-summary long
response: truncated at 2048 tokens, missing medication list
```
Raj: Thanks — can you list the top 3 asks per customer in this thread? I'll bring to triage.
Tom: Arcadia:
- request: deterministic summarization for EHR notes (config flag or model pin)
- pain: long prompts hitting token limits & variable truncation
- ask: example prompt library / canonical templates
Tom: Brightlane:
- request: per-route billing toggle (they need chargeback per team)
- pain: onboarding runs into billing surprise for low-volume prod tests
- ask: clearer quota & test-mode toggle
Lena: Great breakdown. Proposal: create two priority lanes in the tracker—"Onboarding & Docs" and "Billing & Billing UX" and tag token-cost under "Performance". I'll add triage criteria: customer impact, effort, repeatability.
Maya: Can we add severity tags P0/P1/P2? Arcadia items = P1, Brightlane billing = P0 (renewal risk), token-costs = P1.
feedback-bot: Auto-extract tags: onboarding, billing, performance, docs
Raj: @Lena please own the Onboarding lane; @Maya own the Billing lane for initial outreach. I'll own Performance scoring.
Lena: acked. I'll put together a short rubric and post in #product-docs. ETA EOD.
Maya: I'll reach out to Arcadia exec sponsor to confirm priority before triage. Also adding a short prompt set to reproduce truncation cases — Tom can you upload to the shared drive?
Tom: Uploaded to: https://drive.redwood/arcadia/prompt-repro/ — includes 6 examples and raw logs.
Raj: Thanks all. Next steps: Lena create lanes + rubric, Maya contact customers, Raj prep triage. Meeting at 10:30 tomorrow to decide rollouts. :calendar:
Maya: :thumbsup:
Lena: :raised_hands:
